title: DOJ subpoenas Federal Reserve in escalating pressure campaign
summary: The Justice Department has subpoenaed the Fed over chair Jerome Powell's testimony over the central bank's headquarters renovation. Powell calls it part of a pressure campaign over interest rates.
contentText:
The Justice Department has subpoenaed the Fed over chair Jerome Powell's testimony over the central bank's headquarters renovation. Powell calls it part of a pressure campaign over interest rates.

(Image credit: Andre Caballero-Reynolds)
